summary: Reordered the Extensions settings page so the 'Install from a registry' form and the 'Registries' sections render above the 'Installed extensions' section, per the user's request that registries be at the top. Verified via `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` (all 308 tests passing across 5 packages), and live browser screenshot of the running dev server.
decisions: Place 'Install from a registry' (form block) and 'Registries' (`<ExtensionRegistrySection />`) above 'Installed extensions' on the Extensions page, in that order, instead of the prior layout where 'Installed extensions' came first.

Restrict `ExtensionRegistrySection`'s per-registry listing to `registry.extensions.filter((ext) => !ext.linked)` so already-installed entries are not duplicated against the Installed extensions list — they are managed there instead via Unlink.
